<div class="doxyMemberDoc">

<p><a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/namespaces/llvm/check">Check</a> if the store <span class="doxyComputerOutput">Store</span> is a truncstore that can be merged.</p>


<p>That is, it's a store of a shifted value of <span class="doxyComputerOutput">SrcVal</span>. If <span class="doxyComputerOutput">SrcVal</span> is an empty <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/register">Register</a> then it does not need to match and SrcVal is set to the source value found. On match, returns the start byte offset of the <span class="doxyComputerOutput">SrcVal</span> that is being stored.</p>


<p>Definition at line 649 of file <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/files/lib/lib/codegen/lib/codegen/globalisel/loadstoreopt-cpp">LoadStoreOpt.cpp</a>.</p>
